# chat-show --format flag validation (offline; noAuth/noClient command)

# Help lists the new format flags.
exec ./nlm_test chat-show --help
stderr '--format'
stderr 'markdown'
stderr 'html'
stderr '--out'
stderr '--open'

# An unknown format is rejected at argument validation, before any network.
! exec ./nlm_test chat-show --format=bogus nb-1 conv-1
stderr 'usage: nlm chat-show'

# --out without --format=html is a usage error.
! exec ./nlm_test chat-show --out /tmp/x.html --format=text nb-1 conv-1
stderr 'usage: nlm chat-show'

# --open without --format=html is a usage error.
! exec ./nlm_test chat-show --open --format=markdown nb-1 conv-1
stderr 'usage: nlm chat-show'

# A valid format with a missing local session fails at load, not at parsing
# (proves the format itself parsed and validation passed).
! exec ./nlm_test chat-show --format=markdown nb-missing conv-missing
! stderr 'unknown --format'
